Single-line supplement with no shelfmark and a left-pointing arrow near the gutter at about y 1085. On fol. 24 a left-margin arrow sits on the √d.86(7) line at about the same height, so the probable attachment is reasonable. The siglum read as 'RCM' could be 'RLM': the second letter is ambiguous.

Two-line entry beginning with a tick, '√d.147(5)', with a small slanted tick above. The second line ends 'n.d.: 28: 10/14: D'. A left arrow is at the right end, and a right arrow lies on the facing-page margin at the d.641(3) line. The fol. 24 overview shows the fragment '[Tippā ←' from this page at its left edge, which confirms the line is the same. The final vowel of 'Tippa' may carry a macron.
Short line 'ff.1-59 (9 lio[?]), unf.'. A long arrow crosses the gutter from fol. 24, where a matching arrow sits at the √d.173(1) Āhnikacandrikā line. The parenthesis reading is uncertain.

Two-line composite-MS note with curved bracket strokes in the left margin. Its arrow lies just right of the gutter, on the facing page at about [3259,3631], at the height of the √c.164 line on fol. 24. The candidate places it correctly on the facing page; the inventory's 'near gutter' placement is less precise.

'c.165. Do., ff.1-43 inc. and ff.3-58 inc. old MSS.' with 'n.a.: 99: 11/12: D.' on the same baseline. A margin stroke stands before 'c.165'. An arrow on the facing-page margin at about y 3756 aligns with the line below c.164 ('— ext: Pañcapretopākhyāna') on fol. 24.

review.boundary_review: The gutter is at about x 3130. All marks right of it, including the arrows beside b005 and b006 and the right-pointing arrow near b003, are on fol. 24 margins. They are treated as relationship evidence, not target records. The facing-page shelfmarks and cancelled lines are not transcribed. The left edge of the fol. 24 overview shows a fragment of b003 ('[Tippā ←') and of b005/b006 ('…MS, l.12;' and 'D.'); these are not duplicate records.
